indices.title: Equity commentary
indices.body:
MU had a strong report after the bell with revenue up 380% YoY, but is now trading flat, with the broader SMH ETF mirroring the NQ profile.

Again, the rate story and the potential for an Iran deal continues to dominate price action. Market had an extremely bearish close into the quarter. NQ has completely erased that move and is now trading in yesterday's RTH range after a strong rejection from the upper 5M Bollinger band, while ES lags.

Oil: Rallied from 88, and is now trading around 91.

bonds.title: Bond commentary
bonds.body: Treasury yields are still extremely elevated, and continue to create downward pressure on equities. Energy prices and concerns over government spending will be the key drivers.
